summary: Officially Sydere Tower, locally the Departure Lake Tower, in Haggart Township near Highway 11; no source found on its build date or condition today.

evidence.supports: Official name Sydere Tower; also called Departure Lake Tower
evidence.quote: Departure Lake Tower – officially called Sydere Tower

evidence.supports: Departure Lake community in Haggart Township, Cochrane District
evidence.quote: Departure Lake is a dispersed rural community and unincorporated place in geographic Haggart Township, Cochrane District in Northeastern Ontario

evidence.supports: On Highway 11 between Strickland and Smooth Rock Falls
evidence.quote: It is located on Ontario Highway 11 between the communities of Strickland to the west and Smooth Rock Falls to the east.

evidence.supports: Census counts the community as Unorganized North Cochrane District
evidence.quote: The community is counted as part of Unorganized North Cochrane District in Canadian census data.

evidence.supports: Departure Lake 2.8 km south of the community; picnic area at end of North Access Road
evidence.quote: is 2.8 kilometres (1.7 mi) south of the community at the end of North Access Road, where there is a picnic area

evidence.supports: Poplar Rapids River passes under Highway 11 and the railway just east of the community
evidence.quote: the Poplar Rapids River itself passes under Highway 11 and the Ontario Northland Railway just east of the community

notes_for_editor: The record's 1940 build year and its source (geohub.lio.gov.on.ca, dataset mnrf::tower) could not be checked: the cached page is a script-only shell with no readable text, so 1940 is left out of the story. Only the title of the Facebook group post could be read; its body sits behind a login, so any build, staffing or history details in it are unknown here. The record's coordinates (49.182177, -81.806548) were not checked against any source. No source found on staffing, fires, fate, access or the tower's condition today. Low confidence: the story rests on a post title and a community article.
